title: Information Theory, Algorithmic Epistemology, and Artificial Thought

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: John von Neumann created the foundational architecture of modern computing and co-founded game theory (*játékelmélet*). His philosophical inquiry in 'The Computer and the Brain' compared the digital automaton with the electrochemical complexity of the human central nervous system.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Discussing algorithmic epistemology requires balancing technological optimism with skepticism (*kritikai távolságtartás*): *Vajon a számítási kapacitás növekedése elvezethet-e a valódi öntudat megszületéséhez?*
